scope: 26 original screenshot/attachment requests; source status separated from physical acceptance

requests.problem: Earlier tracker did not show each original finding separately.
requests.solution: Retain all 100 findings and their own source references; keep 14 acceptance rows open.
requests.guide: Filter Original findings; compare ID, current evidence and remaining task.
requests.evidence: 100 unique IDs, problems, recommendations and historical statuses retained.

requests.problem: Brand-colored borders appeared on page containers and sections.
requests.solution: Structural panels use neutral line tokens; focus/selected specimens retain semantic treatment.
requests.guide: Inspect unfocused containers, then keyboard focus, in both themes and custom Brand.
requests.evidence: Source distinguishes neutral containers from focus/state tokens. Real screenshot comparison still required.

requests.problem: Text inside composite fields gained a second border.
requests.solution: Composite wrapper owns border/focus; inner input border is zero.
requests.guide: Check outlined/filled/underlined Input, Password, Number and Search in every state.
requests.evidence: Composite CSS reset is present. Actual native field rendering remains pending.

requests.problem: Margins, gutters, section gaps and side spacing were unequal.
requests.solution: Shared logical gutters, stable mirrored scrollbar space and one owner per section gap.
requests.guide: Measure both content edges and sidebar in wide/narrow widths; expand content and retest.
requests.evidence: Shared source rules present; computed box geometry needs a connected renderer.

requests.problem: Unit and other dropdowns did not align with adjacent fields.
requests.solution: Consistent control height, padding and arrow inset; responsive minimum widths.
requests.guide: Compare select/input baseline and bounds at 320/375/768/1440px.
requests.evidence: Control CSS and DOM interaction pass; native popup placement requires browser verification.

requests.problem: Section headings were larger than page titles and used conflicting sizes.
requests.solution: Restore standard H1-H6 defaults and bind every role metric to shared tokens.
requests.guide: Reset Typography; inspect hierarchy; change size, weight, line height, tracking and color.
requests.evidence: Role resolution, legacy migration, metric bindings and editor option checks pass. Visual release acceptance remains separate.

requests.problem: Selected font and typography values did not propagate across the design.
requests.solution: Default headings/body use Inter; live shared resolver applies family and every role metric.
requests.guide: Change font; navigate; reload; inspect exported source/assets and copied current context.
requests.evidence: Model/DOM bindings and durable settings pass. Real font decoding is an open asset check.

requests.problem: Contrast labels and metadata used oversized body copy.
requests.solution: Caption metadata follows the 11px default Caption role and full role metrics.
requests.guide: Inspect contrast descriptions, RGB readouts, eyebrows and helpers; test Caption customization.
requests.evidence: All metadata bindings use Caption metrics; rendered sizing remains part of acceptance.

requests.problem: Contrast pills needed 12px Regular typography.
requests.solution: Contrast tags use 12px, weight 400, with readable own-background pass/fail foregrounds.
requests.guide: Inspect AA/AAA and Non-text 3:1 pills in light/dark and custom panels.
requests.evidence: 12px/400 source binding and 4.5:1 default/custom panel model checks pass.

requests.problem: Long descriptions expanded too far and toggles appeared inconsistently.
requests.solution: Measure prose overflow against four line heights; only overflowing content gets an accessible expand/collapse button.
requests.guide: Check 3/4/5-line prose, resize, expand/collapse, keyboard and text-spacing overrides.
requests.evidence: Four-line measurement/clamp and retained expansion implemented; actual line wrapping cannot be certified in jsdom.

requests.problem: Section tabs used unjoined underlined links.
requests.solution: Joined Outlined Group Button tracks with active state, focus and keyboard behavior.
requests.guide: Click every section and Human/Machine choice; use arrows/Home/End; check overflow track.
requests.evidence: Group navigation regression tests and 14-page section/view checks pass.

requests.problem: Tracking input did not match neighboring typography fields.
requests.solution: One shared type-editor control height applies to input and unit select.
requests.guide: Compare tracking, line-height, font and size fields after unit/font changes.
requests.evidence: Identical height, box sizing, typography and border recipe present; rendered geometry pending.

requests.problem: Paired tracking and unit fields used a different gap.
requests.solution: Tracking pair uses the same 16px spacing token, flexible numeric width and bounded select.
requests.guide: Compare paired input gap with adjacent editor columns at multiple widths.
requests.evidence: Specific tracking selector uses --space-16; shared 4px wrapper rule does not override its higher specificity.

requests.problem: Unit selection failed and was shown on unrelated pages.
requests.solution: Working shared radios/paired controls; toolbar unit choice appears on seven dimensional Foundations.
requests.guide: Switch px/rem on Typography, Grid, Spacing, Radius, Borders, Shadows, Icons; inspect conversion/save/copy.
requests.evidence: Both units and 224 theme/unit/density/direction cases pass. Colors/AI/Guidelines do not get irrelevant unit selectors.

requests.problem: Export Foundation JSON stayed beside the unit labels.
requests.solution: Auto start margin sends export to the right; narrow layouts wrap within available width.
requests.guide: Inspect toolbar with and without unit selector; narrow width and long labels.
requests.evidence: Responsive flex rule present. Current JSON export passed on all nine Foundations.

requests.problem: Copied prompts omitted equivalent rem values.
requests.solution: Dimensional prompts show both units; component, pattern and template prompts include current Foundation settings.
requests.guide: Switch units; copy prompt; compare dimensions and current applied settings.
requests.reference: foundation-model.js; foundation-runtime.js; all 63 component detail scripts
requests.evidence: All 131 component pages plus Patterns/Templates pass both-unit and changed-setting copy checks.

requests.problem: Project banner radius differed from other sections.
requests.solution: Banner, panels, action buttons and joined groups use their matching semantic radius role.
requests.guide: Change radius philosophy; compare banner/panel outer corners and inner controls.
requests.evidence: Shared --radius-md role bindings and numeric-versus-semantic radius tests pass; pixel comparison pending.

requests.problem: Edit setup text CTA and icon placement/style did not match requested design.
requests.solution: Use named Google Material edit icon, icon-only accessible CTA after Export on the right.
requests.guide: Inspect accessible name, SVG provenance, ordering and activation.
requests.evidence: Reviewed licensed edit path, accessible name and DOM ordering are present.

requests.problem: Header icons hovered to their unchanged default foreground.
requests.solution: Topbar icons and banner actions change to Brand on hover; active uses pressed Brand.
requests.guide: Hover theme/settings/edit/close; check SVG/mask currentColor in both themes.
requests.evidence: Previously equal default/hover token fixed; currentColor icon source retained. Physical hover rendering pending.

requests.problem: Project context needed floating behavior and dismissal.
requests.solution: Sticky context banner includes Close, restores focus and updates sticky scroll offset.
requests.guide: Scroll content, close banner, navigate/reopen context and check focus/section reachability.
requests.evidence: Sticky banner, explicit close state and context-height updates are present; scroll painting needs browser.

requests.problem: Scrolling exposed excess page tail/blank space.
requests.solution: Viewport-bounded shell; main/sidebar scroll inside minmax row; consistent bottom padding; no elastic outer tail.
requests.guide: Scroll every page to bottom at desktop/mobile and resize; check final content/actions remain reachable.
requests.evidence: Shell height/min-height/overscroll and terminal section margin fixes present; physical scroll check still open.

requests.problem: Categories lacked customization; numeric values and rows aligned inconsistently.
requests.solution: All 24 controls apply current formats; three-column rows and grouped separators; protect IDs/phones; date/range/Unicode recovery.
requests.guide: Edit each format, save/reload/copy; test empty/loading/masked/escaped/date/number examples and invalid boundaries.
requests.evidence: 59 edits, all offered options, 48 locale/separator/group cases and identity/alignment scenarios pass. Visual column acceptance pending.

requests.problem: Reference rows had wrong columns and inconsistent spacing.
requests.solution: Three-column documentation layout, responsive stacking, protected description expansion and neutral separators.
requests.guide: Expand each description; inspect status alignment and panel/row gaps at narrow/wide widths.
requests.evidence: 20 DOM checks pass; actual layout, zoom and assistive-technology checks remain pending.

requests.problem: Inputs, views, saves, resets and copies needed full functional verification.
requests.solution: Exercise every offered editor option plus invalid/save/recovery paths and defined matrices; fix current-prompt propagation.
requests.guide: Repeat the committed DOM tools; inspect each evidence JSON and any failed row before release.
requests.evidence: 2205 main checks, 32 recovery checks, 141 pending checks, 817 defined combinations; zero failures. Arbitrary input space is not exhaustively tested.

requests.problem: Mandatory fields still allowed Required text instead of the requested marker.
requests.solution: Required labels use * in Foundation danger color; native required/ARIA stays programmatic; conflicting dropdown guidance corrected.
requests.guide: Inspect required form labels and error summary; verify one explanation of the marker.
requests.evidence: Shared indicator runtime and corrected guideline are present; actual announcements need AT acceptance.

requests.problem: Optional label text cluttered non-mandatory fields.
requests.solution: Shared indicator normalization removes optional badges; optional identity no longer blocks Project setup.
requests.guide: Inspect setup/other optional fields; leave blank and complete review/save.
requests.evidence: Optional marker removal and profile/identity regression checks pass.

followupFixes.problem: 65 page drivers reported Copied even when clipboard and fallback failed.
followupFixes.solution: Shared awaited copy feedback checks actual success and announces manual-copy recovery.
followupFixes.guide: Copy with normal API, denied API and failing/successful legacy fallback; preserve focus.
followupFixes.reference: shell.js; all component detail scripts; patterns.js; templates.js
followupFixes.evidence: 131 component pages plus Patterns/Templates pass copy success/failure/focus paths.

followupFixes.problem: Component/pattern/template prompts missed current settings and dimension equivalence.
followupFixes.solution: Prepare page Markdown with current applied snapshot and both units; keep code outputs valid code.
followupFixes.guide: Change Spacing then copy each prompt; compare applied setting and px/rem values.
followupFixes.reference: foundation-runtime.js; component detail scripts; patterns.js; templates.js
followupFixes.evidence: Each of 133 library pages passed a changed-setting prompt check.

followupFixes.problem: Divider was pointer-only with no min panes, saved ratio or cancellation recovery.
followupFixes.solution: Accessible separator controller, RTL/vertical keyboard, collapse/restore, physical minima, pointer cancel and versioned persistence.
followupFixes.guide: Arrow/Shift/Home/End/Enter; cancel pointer; reload width; future record; failed reset then retry.
followupFixes.evidence: Actual page-script interaction, bounds, save, reset and future-record scenarios pass; physical drag layout pending.

followupFixes.problem: Eight patterns lacked buildable transitions; Master-Detail had no working state/focus example.
followupFixes.solution: Per-pattern contracts plus executable selected/empty/loading/error/retry/back example and stale-request protection.
followupFixes.guide: Select record, Back, retry error, clear during load, cross narrow/wide threshold.
followupFixes.evidence: Simulated media transitions, list position, focus return, loading/error and stale cancellation pass.

followupFixes.problem: IDs/phones formatted as quantities, dates aligned as numbers, Unicode masks split characters and invalid ranges leaked.
followupFixes.solution: Protect identity labels/leading zeros; numeric-only alignment; code-point masks; ordered valid ranges.
followupFixes.guide: Format IDs, phone, boolean/blank number, date-only values, reverse range and emoji masks.
followupFixes.evidence: Model fixtures and actual table value/alignment checks pass.

followupFixes.problem: Header default and hover mapped to the same text color.
followupFixes.solution: Hover Brand and active pressed Brand apply to icon-only header controls.
followupFixes.guide: Hover settings/theme/navigation and banner actions; verify currentColor paths/masks.
followupFixes.evidence: Different state tokens are present; real hover painting still needs browser.

followupFixes.problem: 12px status pills could be unreadable on their own tinted backgrounds.
followupFixes.solution: Derive foreground/background pairs with at least 4.5:1, retaining 12px Regular.
followupFixes.guide: Check pass/fail pairs in both themes and white/dark/blue panels.

followupFixes.problem: Published token file omitted runtime semantic roles and metrics.
followupFixes.solution: Generate from the shared default resolver, both themes, with source/model/contract freshness.
followupFixes.guide: Independent import; compare all property names and representative values; reject invalid/cyclic inputs.
followupFixes.evidence: 613 typed tokens + 21 explicit CSS-only keywords restore all 634 default properties in each mode.
